title: Princess 32M
description:
After an intensive interior and exterior refit in 2023 and 2024, this Princess 32M ranks among the best 32-metre yachts on the market. She features a raised pilothouse with a main-deck master suite, five guest cabins and three crew cabins.

Highlights include new teak decks, an upgraded bridge, TRAC zero-speed stabilisers, hydraulic thrusters, a hardtop with sunroof and a Williams 505 tender. RINA certified in 2024, she is lying in Phuket, Thailand.
